name: Goledo PPI collateral priced from Swappi spot reserves
summary: Goledo (Aave v2 fork) listed PPI as 65%-LTV collateral priced by a custom feed that multiplies Pyth CFX/USD by the instantaneous WCFX/PPI reserve ratio of a Swappi pair. A flash-swapped 11M WCFX buy inflated the PPI oracle price 71x inside one transaction, letting 8.67M deposited PPI borrow the pool's xCFX, WCFX, NUT, WBTC, ETH, USDT, USDC and ABC liquidity.

loss.notes: Exact reserve outflows from the single exploit transaction. A 6,000,000 xCFX deposit made by the attack contract from its own first borrow (onBehalfOf 0xfa6b93b1bfef8bd325d88ffc61d02627505fea86) and re-borrowed in the same transaction is excluded as attacker-supplied input; the attacker's 8.67M PPI collateral left in the pool is not netted. CEX freezes of proceeds do not reduce gross loss. Prices are pre-exploit DefiLlama quotes, consistent with Goledo's own oracle at block 88464094.

ageReset.description: LendingPoolConfigurator.configureReserveAsCollateral(PPI, 6500, 7500, 11000) raised PPI's LTV from 0 to 65%, first letting PPI priced by the spot-reserve feed back borrows. getConfiguration(PPI) across block 86347750 moves from the post-listing word (LTV 0) to LTV 6500/threshold 7500/bonus 11000; the same block's enableBorrowingOnReserve(PPI) (idx 33) and setReserveFactor(PPI) (idx 44) also write this word but are not exercised by the exploit. No later PPI configuration or implementation change precedes the exploit.
Immutable PPI price feed whose fetchPrice returns Pyth CFX/USD times the live Swappi WCFX/PPI reserve ratio; its pair, token, Pyth and price-id storage are set only in the constructor.

limitations: Not the knot: the feed became exploitable collateral pricing only after the later AaveOracle source assignment (block 86347720) and PPI LTV activation (block 86347750, target-1).

ageReset.description: AaveOracle.setAssetSources([PPI],[0xd79d5c49...]) assigned the spot-reserve feed as PPI's price source; getSourceOfAsset(PPI) moves from zero to the feed across block 86347720. It is the only PPI source assignment before the exploit.

limitations: Not the knot: PPI LTV activation at block 86347750 (target-1) is the later causal reset.

sources.note: Reviewed anchor, root cause and earliest exercise. Attacker EOA 0x0ad18233211303e93831604c62b5e76c6530a305 (confluxscan evmapi account.txlist, 10 txs) deployed attack contract 0xa66b15ff3b9e31f579d06d70b527ad0a8f2ffb58 in 0xb409fb75b61f8f246252f9b72e31460fb55373dd6a7efbf1f72f33136b150e4d (block 88463645) and called it once with selector 0x4449f6c1 in source-1 (block 88464095, tx index 0, timestamp 1706397336, status 1, 152 logs); its only other call (0xec9b9a937945bf498ca970a32eba0903c2061847c417925f8faa5cf63eb93d76, block 88464320, selector 0xb6875a28) emits no logs. On 2024-01-29 the same EOA sent 0xcb6c84324030365d00ac9e02785b662876127da6 the calldata text 'I hacked Goledo and want to negotiate 20240128' (0x9359dbee49fdb2567612908a419a95034df34af86874a0761f1e9111596526d9). trace_transaction (parity; debug_traceTransaction is not allowed on https://evm.confluxrpc.com) of source-1: Swappi WCFX pair 0x949b78ef2c8d6979098e195b08f27ff99cb20448 flash-swaps WCFX to the attack contract (log 0: 11,000,000 WCFX), which swaps through router 0x62b0873055bf896dd869e172119871ac24aea305 into the PPI/WCFX pair 0x1112a6c61a2eec4bd3aec78bd5bf3396bdd37d57, then calls LendingPool proxy 0x9aeba63d77d25c95dadd057db74741517862f360 deposit(PPI) (Deposit log 18: 8,665,742.736761333835241228 PPI) and eight borrow() calls (Borrow logs 27,36,45,54,63,72,81,90) plus a 6,000,000 xCFX deposit onBehalfOf 0xfa6b93b1bfef8bd325d88ffc61d02627505fea86 (log 98) and a further 6,000,000 xCFX borrow (log 104). Each borrow's validateBorrow prices PPI via AaveOracle 0x93904ce43a4d7a9820549aae265a042998be4323 getAssetPrice -> source 0xd79d5c49fed01d566c00b2f6eb61b4adc135e935 fetchPrice() (0x0fdb11cf), which staticcalls Pyth 0xe9d69cdd6fe41e7b621b4a688c5d1a68cb5c8adc getPriceUnsafe(CFX/USD id 0x8879170230c9603342f3837cf9a8e76c61791198fb1271bb2552c9af7b33c933) and the PPI/WCFX pair token0() and getReserves(). Trace frame [0,1,13,0,2,0]: Pyth 21454999e-8, reserves WCFX 12,476,617.16 / PPI 3,311,858.40, fetchPrice returns 0x0b37887403f0f400 = 0.80826469e18 = Pyth x reserveWCFX/reservePPI exactly. eth_call getAssetPrice(PPI) at block 88464094 = 11346290000000000 (reserves 1,476,617.16 WCFX / 27,921,735.05 PPI), so the flash swap inflated the collateral price 71.2x within the transaction. PPI collateral 8.67M x 0.808 x LTV 65% supports the ~$4.5M borrowed at oracle prices. The Goledo post-mortem (source-2) describes the same PPI price manipulation; the lead's 'empty-market rounding' description does not match the onchain mechanism (PPI had 291 prior deposits). Earliest-exercise scan: confluxscan evmapi logs.getLogs on the LendingPool for Borrow topic 0xc6a898309e823ee50bac64e45ca8adba6690e99e7841c45d754e2a38e9019d9b over blocks 86347700..88464095 (723 logs, 715 txs, last in source-1) and Deposit topic 0xde6857219544bb5b7746f48ed30be6386fefc61b2f864cacf559893bf50fd951 with topic1=PPI over 86347700..88470595 (291 logs, first 86353357); eth_getTransactionReceipt of all 1005 distinct txs shows Swap (0xd78ad95f...) logs from the PPI/WCFX pair only in source-1. The 0xd79d5c49 feed is referenced only by AaveOracle for PPI. Post-exploit Borrow logs 88464096..88470595 (33) are PPI borrows by 0x3ff8788f9172d77a9688939bc00442c7be9042bf and WCFX/NUT borrows by depositors at PPI prices 0.0083-0.0158 USD, not collateral inflation; they are not merged. Pool admin 0x9141f4c8eacbe56490d0d52184f590dee4c4799e paused the pool via configurator setPoolPause(true) in 0x23a5a68ebbbc94b9813003bc4965ed99d4c7ed7e887b4a229e18006a781da33e (block 88470595).

Reviewed gross victim depletion from source-1 receipt Transfer logs whose from is a Goledo gToken (underlying reserve holder; gToken addresses from LendingPool.getReserveData at block 88464094, field 8): log 26 gxCFX 0x06fb6757aa45e317fed3188144bcb0b72f2e7bb7 -> attack contract 9560202.822366275844629855 xCFX; log 35 gWCFX 0x884a1599f360f61272c0814c2e423cc8345d6476 1706617.500505458673870161 WCFX; log 44 gNUT 0xcba81566c4d9cd22f685fc77d0739cb5e4571208 11181.476535310540113911 NUT; log 53 gWBTC 0xde75097fce76a3c5402ba6875f670e75e26b890c 1.615997534227385163 WBTC; log 62 gETH 0x281cef1a6b21cd692f4577922029225af4ffff98 15.343500403720339463 ETH; log 71 gUSDT 0xe8234d58764a342b7b51ae4e1cf05c3454c7bfb6 99229.658254937175137146 USDT; log 80 gUSDC 0xf20e046689adf30711a67aff975f16d47fe72aba 13942.680270837176642585 USDC; log 89 gABC 0xd953c0e492aa524ad051d2f6d6d406b2e5a50523 67715.739860474718672691 ABC; log 103 gxCFX 6000000 xCFX. Inflows to gTokens: log 12 8665742.736761333835241228 PPI (attacker collateral, attacker-supplied, not netted against loss) and log 92 6000000 xCFX deposited by the attack contract onBehalfOf 0xfa6b93b1bfef8bd325d88ffc61d02627505fea86 from the first xCFX borrow and re-borrowed at log 103. That 6,000,000 xCFX round trip is identifiable attacker-supplied input and is excluded, leaving 9560202.822366275844629855 xCFX (gross outflow 15,560,202.82). The 0xfa6b gxCFX claim was never withdrawn (confluxscan tokentx shows only the mint in source-1). All nine tokens return decimals()=18. Valuation: DefiLlama historical prices at the exploit timestamp, each observed 7-32 s before the exploit block and therefore before the attacker's in-transaction disposals; they agree within 0.3% with AaveOracle.getAssetPrice at block 88464094 (WCFX 0.21455, xCFX 0.24006, NUT 10.0648, WBTC 42098.68, ETH 2266.62, USDT 1.000008, USDC 1.00005, ABC 1.8117). Total 3,112,177.71 USD. The widely reported 1.7M USD is the attacker's ~7.9M CFX net swap profit (source-2), not gross pool depletion; Goledo's onchain message 0xb4cfceb361cfc21dc93ec252591a4d9587645cbf96d16b28f1c9013f66fad780 estimates total asset loss at ~3.8M USD. CEX freezes of attacker proceeds do not reduce gross loss.

Reviewed artifact identity and age history of the PPI price feed 0xd79d5c49fed01d566c00b2f6eb61b4adc135e935. Unverified on confluxscan (contract.getsourcecode returns empty SourceCode); behaviour established from bytecode and source-1 trace: fetchPrice() (0x0fdb11cf) = Pyth getPriceUnsafe(storage slot 3 price id) x reserve(token = slot 1, WCFX) / reserve(PPI) of the pair in slot 0 (0x1112a6c61a2eec4bd3aec78bd5bf3396bdd37d57), i.e. an instantaneous AMM spot price with no TWAP or deviation bound, reproduced exactly in source-1 frame [0,1,13,0,2,0]. eth_getStorageAt at block 88464094: slot0 pair, slot1 WCFX, slot2 Pyth, slot3 CFX/USD id, slot4 8. Deployment: source tx 0x3667a0adc1ab71d97a87232d3556d480c4d451f3485f112c1dad80a284bacdae, block 86347710, tx index 26, top-level CREATE by 0x4945491a91d9fa94050922cac3f5e3a18ce2120d (receipt contractAddress = feed). eth_getCode empty at 86347709; keccak256 runtime 0x045dfdecaad50b079f4236a0d57b51a6d74073602c70dc9f52ae7b512c71044f (3323 bytes) at 86347710 and 88464094. Runtime contains no DELEGATECALL-based upgrade path and confluxscan account.txlist for the feed has only the creation tx, so slots 0-3 were fixed by the constructor. Not the knot: the feed became exploitable as Goledo collateral pricing only after AaveOracle wiring (target-3, block 86347720) and PPI LTV activation (target-1, block 86347750), both later.

EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc = 0xd4ab8ed301e4f43a00526802867256ebf92c063c at blocks 61180200, 86347750 and 88464094; confluxscan logs.getLogs for Upgraded topic 0xbc7cd75a20ee27fd9adebab32041f755214dbc6bffa90cc0225b39da2e5c2d3b over 61180000..83033864 and 83033865..88464094 returns none (a later post-exploit upgrade to 0x0049cf13ba124be3d3702ac97aea62c5e45ca7c3 is outside the window). Implementation (verified LendingPool, v0.7.6) created at 0xc396df7294091742e1ae0508be5ec3a7796095e04d6fcb046fa33ee52ea85016 block 61180185; empty at 61180184; runtime keccak 0xd6b3dbcc771fc3644696fba63f97dbaf27976bcda8e85fe23e14e068f0c9df4b at 61180185 and 88464094. PPI listing history via LendingPoolConfigurator proxy 0x4fb3f6faa75e9795e0fe930a7b9405fa162327b7 (confluxscan account.txlist, 38 txs from block 80000000; PPI first appears at 86347700): batchInitReserve(PPI) 0x8eba16acc14d38de675dadbf32b054567dc2bb77f44ea11b703967c172f2abde (block 86347700, idx 6) leaves getConfiguration(PPI) = 0x...0112000000000000 (LTV 0, active); block 86347750 carries enableBorrowingOnReserve(PPI,true) idx 33, configureReserveAsCollateral(PPI,6500,7500,11000) idx 39 (CollateralConfigurationChanged log 22) and setReserveFactor(PPI,5000) idx 44. eth_call LendingPool.getConfiguration(PPI) (calldata below) returns 0x...0112000000000000 at 86347749 and 0x...13880d122af81d4c1964 at 86347750 and 88464094 (LTV 0x1964=6500, liquidation threshold 7500, bonus 11000). Only the idx-39 write is necessary to the exploit: with LTV 0 PPI gives no borrowing power, so this call first made the spot-priced PPI usable as borrow collateral; borrowing enablement and reserve factor on PPI are not exercised (the attacker did not borrow PPI). No later configurator call touches PPI before the exploit (next calls are ABC listing at 88128415..88128470 and the pause at 88470595). LendingPool code consumes the causal state and the feed output; this is the latest pre-exploit reset of the vulnerable combination, so it is the knot. Age 1706397336 - 1703750427 = 2646909 s.
